name: asic-1ghz-hbm
label: unvalidated scenario
description: A hypothetical 1 GHz openTPU slice (D=128, MCOLS=4; the NanGate45 points in docs/asic.md reach 340-386 MHz on a 45 nm educational library, so 1 GHz assumes a modern node) with its 8-channel native port on HBM2e. Core clock, controller clock, memory data rate and latency are separate parameters here and are never derived from the FPGA by a clock ratio. No receipt exists for any number this profile produces.
